summary:
The source candidate adds an advisory lifecycleObservation to the existing LEARN private snapshot analyzer using retained admissions, starts, terminals and times. Process-start presence requires process rows; distinct process observations, threads and turns survive repeated phases. Duplicate retained identities and the receiver's actual thread/turn semantic keys refuse. Missing historical relations remain unavailable, missing retained identity/outcome columns remain explicit, and malformed, foreign or oversized present relations refuse. Each relation retains the10000-row bound and existing outer snapshot byte limits; diagnostic samples cap at20 with exact omitted counts.

Timestamp presence, multiple observations and apparent within-row reversal warnings are descriptive evidence. Equal clock labels do not prove a shared clock domain. Missing terminal evidence remains unresolved across interruption/restart; late arrival belongs to another retained snapshot. No durations, observed waits or critical paths are inferred. Existing token, native-source, shared-cost and enrollment predicates retain their meaning; waitCoverage remains unknown, criticalPath not-evaluated and native population coverage not-assessed.

This independently useful source capability can proceed while authentic native provisioner/profile/inventory supply remains pending for dependent operation. The candidate changes no producer wire schema, SQLite migration, journal, executor or operating authority. Source controls establish inert analyzer behavior only; independent source review, required exact-head CI and protected delivery remain separate from installed/native capture, LEARN experiments and full outcome acceptance.

Receiver text validation remains non-whitespace without an added input length ceiling. Complete identities stay internal for joins, ordering and duplicates; oversized diagnostic strings render a bounded prefix, character count and full ASCII-JSON-string digest. Timestamp evidence requires the existing RFC3339 shape plus valid calendar, time-of-day, numeric offset and UTC/local range. The source controls distinguish valid long inputs from malformed present evidence and retain the original failed24:00 normalization control; no source test becomes native authority.
title: Selected-snapshot lifecycle evidence does not establish waits or runtime completeness
